title: FNIRSI HS-02A 100W Portable Corded Soldering Iron Kit, 3S Fast Heating, 212-842℉, Pre-set 3 Groups Temperature, 6 F245 Soldering Tips, Smart Digital Soldering Iron Pen Tool for Electronics Repair
bullets: 【FNIRSI HS02 Soldering Iron】We upgraded HS01, HS02 has a better grip, shorter tip, larger 0.96'' display, and faster heating speed.It is suitable for electronic component repair, jewellery repair, circuit board soldering, micro soldering.
【Supports up to 100W & 3 S Tinning】Handles up to 100W (9–20V). Runs smoothly even at lower power. If restart occurs, simply switch to Adaptive Power Mode or lower the voltage for safe.
【Portable and Lightweight】We provide a storage case for the soldering pen, which will make it easier for you to carry it outside.Its ergonomics are ensures greater results and comfort
【3 Groups Pre-set Temp】Preset multiple groups of fixed temperature, fast temperature adjustment without time-consuming.The temperature is adjustable within the range of 212-842 °F.
【Smart & Safe】 features sleep, automatic power-off, and other modes.Customize setting,set soldering iron parameters according to needs to meet daily usage.

【Extensive Accessories】 HS02A is equipped with 6 soldering iron tips (K、KU、JS、I、C2、B). The integrated design allows the soldering iron to heat up quickly and maintain a stable temperature.The 100W charging adapter allows you to use it immediately.
